text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Privatisation minister Abdrrahman Saaidi pledges transparency in running state-owned companies sell-off.
- Court sentences two people for trafficking money.
- Morocco and Spain are negotiating debt rescheduling deal.
- Morocco's Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali will participate in the opening of gas pipeline in Algeria on November 1.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj rules out Dirham devaluation.
- Morocco's PM says the government has set a priority to develop the country's northern regions with Western help.
